name: Nurture (slow drip)
description: Long-cycle keep-warm for opps that are not ready now — soft texts + emails over ~90 days. Mark a lead Nurture from My leads to put them on this board.

stages.label: Day 14 · Soft check-in
stages.hint: First nurture touch — light value, no hard close.

stages.label: Day 28 · Soft text
stages.hint: Short respectful ping ~2 weeks after the check-in email.

stages.label: Day 45 · Research note
stages.hint: Share a useful angle (repeat jobs / ops) without pressure.

stages.label: Day 60 · Soft text
stages.hint: Second soft text — booking link only if they want it.

stages.label: Day 75 · Why now
stages.hint: Gentle timing email — still easy to ignore.

stages.label: Day 90 · Soft close
stages.hint: Last nurture touch — leave the door open.
